item.title: Inside the Trump administration's AI 'Tech Force' designed to modernize the government
item.description: Trump's AI "Tech Force" plans to bring 1,000 engineers into federal agencies through partnerships with Microsoft, Palantir, and other tech giants.

item.title: Target cuts 500 jobs, invests more money in store staffing
item.description: Target plans to cut 500 office and supply chain jobs while investing more in frontline store workers as part of CEO Michael Fiddelke's turnaround strategy.

item.title: Apple News boosts left-leaning news outlets, shuts out conservative sources: watchdog
item.description: Apple News bias study finds 440 left-leaning articles versus zero conservative stories in January, according to Media Research Center analysis of featured articles.

item.title: Saks to close stores amid bankruptcy proceedings
item.description: Saks signaled it's planning to close eight Saks Fifth Avenue locations and one Neiman Marcus store as the fashion and style retailer refocuses its operations.

item.title: Housing market cools as price growth hits slowest pace since Great Recession recovery
item.description: The housing market cooled dramatically as home price growth slowed to just 0.9% in December, the weakest pace since the economy was recovering from the Great Recession.

item.title: Airlines suspend Cuba flights amid jet fuel shortage after Trump tariff threats on oil shipments to island
item.description: Multiple airlines halt Cuba service amid reported fuel crisis. Thousands affected as carriers scramble to arrange emergency return flights.

item.title: Trump to Kudlow: ‘This country should have the lowest interest rates in the world’
item.description: Trump calls for "lowest interest rates in the world" during a FOX Business interview, claiming rate cuts could eliminate federal deficit and boost the economy.

item.title: Jaguar Land Rover recalling 2,300 electric vehicles in US over fire risk
item.description: Jaguar Land Rover recalled nearly 2,300 I-Pace electric SUVs over a fire risk from overheating batteries, with owners urged to park outside and limit charging to 90%.

item.title: Ring founder addresses FBI recovery of doorbell footage in Nancy Guthrie disappearance case
item.description: Ring founder Jamie Siminoff says Ring does not retain deleted footage without a subscription as the FBI confirms video was recovered from backend systems in the Nancy Guthrie disappearance.

item.title: Stanford psychiatrist testifies Meta's social media platforms is designed to be addictive in NM lawsuit
item.description: Stanford expert testifies Meta's social media features are addictive like a "drug," especially for youth, in New Mexico lawsuit against the tech giant.
